function.name: weather_forecast_get_prediction
function.description: Fetches the weather prediction for a specified location and date range, including temperature, precipitation chances, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographical location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'London, UK'.

start_date.description: The start date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

units.description: The unit system used for the weather forecast results.

include_details.description: A flag indicating whether to include detailed forecast information such as hourly data.

### The “Best” Men’s Underwear Styles – A Quick Guide When it comes to men’s underwear, “best” is a mix of comfort, fit, durability, and style. Below is a rundown of the most popular styles, what they’re best for, and key features to look for when shopping. | Style | What It Looks Like | Ideal For | Key Features | |-------|--------------------|-----------|--------------| | **Boxer Briefs** | Long‑legged briefs that cover the hips and thighs. | Everyday wear, sports, travel. | • Full coverage, supportive fit.
• Good for preventing chafing.
• Available in cotton, modal, microfiber, and performance blends. | | **Briefs (Classic)** | Short‑legged, snug fit that stays in place. | Work, gym, casual. | • Tight support, minimal bulk.
• Great for tight pants.
• Usually made of cotton or a cotton‑blend. | | **Boxers** | Loose, breathable, short‑legged. | Sleep, lounging, light activity. | • Air‑flow, relaxed fit.
• Often made of cotton or bamboo.
• Not ideal for tight pants. | | **Trunks** | Short‑legged, similar to boxer briefs but with a shorter leg. | Fashion, gym, everyday. | • Modern silhouette, less bulk than briefs.
• Good for low‑rise pants. | | **Jockstrap** | Supportive waistband with a pouch and a thin elastic band. | Sports, high‑impact activities. | • Excellent support for active use.
• Minimal coverage, good ventilation. | | **Compression Shorts** | Tight, full‑coverage shorts that compress the thighs. | Athletic performance, recovery. | • Muscle support, reduced vibration.
• Usually made of spandex blends. | | **Bamboo/Modal** | Made from natural fibers, often blended with cotton. | Eco‑friendly, sensitive skin. | • Soft, breathable, moisture‑wicking.
• Hypoallergenic. | | **Performance/Tech** | Designed for moisture management, anti‑odor, and quick‑dry. | Athletes, hot climates. | • Advanced fabrics (e.g., polyester blends).
• Anti‑microbial treatments. | --- #### How to Pick the Right Style 1. **Consider Your Daily Activities** - **Active Lifestyle**: Go for compression shorts or performance briefs. - **Office/Work**: Boxer briefs or classic briefs keep you comfortable under suits or slacks. - **Sleep/Lounging**: Boxers or loose‑fit briefs are best. 2. **Fit Matters** - **Waistband**: Should sit comfortably at the natural waist without digging. - **Leg Length**: For boxer briefs, the leg should reach just above the knee for most people. - **Support**: Look for a pouch or supportive waistband if you need extra support. 3. **Fabric Choice** - **Cotton**: Breathable, soft, but can retain moisture. - **Bamboo/Modal**: Ultra‑soft, moisture‑wicking, eco‑friendly. - **Performance Blends**: Polyester, nylon, spandex for moisture control and stretch. 4. **Durability & Care** - Check the care label: some performance fabrics need gentle washing. - Look for reinforced stitching at the waistband and leg seams. 5. **Style & Color** - Neutral colors (black, navy, gray) are versatile. - If you like a pop of color, choose a subtle stripe or pattern. --- #### Top Brands (as of 2026) | Brand | Known For | Best Product Line | |-------|-----------|-------------------| | **Calvin Klein** | Classic briefs & boxer briefs | “CK Briefs” | | **Uniqlo** | Affordable, high‑quality basics | “Airism” line | | **Under Armour** | Performance fabrics | “UA Tech” briefs | | **Lululemon** | Premium, breathable | “Align” briefs | | **Tommy John** | Comfort‑centric, innovative | “Second Skin” briefs | | **Hanes** | Budget friendly | “Comfort” briefs | | **Bamboo & Modal** | Eco‑friendly | “Bamboo Basics” | --- #### Quick FAQ | Question | Answer | |----------|--------| | **What’s the difference between boxer briefs and trunks?** | Trunks have a shorter leg length, giving a more modern, streamlined look. Boxer briefs are longer and offer more coverage. | | **Can I wear boxer briefs in a suit?** | Yes, if you choose a low‑rise, seamless style that stays hidden under tailored pants. | | **Do performance fabrics smell?** | Most modern performance fabrics have anti‑odor treatments, but it’s still a good idea to wash them after each use. | | **How often should I replace my underwear?** | Every 6–12 months, depending on wear and fabric quality. | --- #### Bottom Line - **For everyday comfort**: Boxer briefs or classic briefs. - **For active or athletic use**: Compression shorts or performance briefs. - **For lounging or sleep**: Boxers or loose‑fit briefs. - **For eco‑friendly options**: Bamboo or modal fabrics. Pick the style that matches your lifestyle, prioritize a good fit, and choose a fabric that feels right for your skin. Happy shopping!
